readmePresentation.description: Native HTML tables link individual raster previews to unchanged full-size sources. Monster previews use proportion-preserving square padding; earlier JPEG contact sheets are historical capture artifacts.

sections.heading: Enemies
sections.layout: Eight family heading rows each span five columns above their T1–T5 forms. There is no separate family column or tier header. Optional caption line breaks keep names from forcing horizontal overflow on narrow screens. Each top-aligned image and compact raised caption share a cell. Proportional square images fill five equally requested 20% columns across the full README width; +30 more families footer.

sections.heading: Equipment
sections.layout: Nine complete five-piece sets grouped by armor class; ranks F, D, and S. Top-aligned proportional square images fill five equally requested columns across the full README width, without a fixed pixel size limit.

sections.heading: Skills
sections.layout: Four category rows with centered category labels and seven ascending F–S rank columns requesting 12.8% each. Each top-aligned image and compact raised caption share a cell instead of separate padded rows. A soft hyphen lets Weaponsmithing wrap only when necessary. Equal-length nonbreaking rank headers in monospace keep column minimum widths consistent on narrow screens. All previews use the same 448 × 512 canvas and 496-pixel visible artwork height, preserving each original frame aspect ratio. Images fill their cells proportionally; native horizontal scrolling remains available on narrow screens.

previewExport.fit: trim transparent bounds, scale uniformly to common height, center
